The game registry is a single map from slug to lazy import, at `src/games/registry.ts:12`. Each entry is `{ slug, title, load }`, where `load` is a dynamic `import()` so a game's bundle is only fetched when its route is first visited (`src/routes/GameRoute.tsx:38`).

Adding a game means adding one entry there and nothing else: the route, the card on the activities page and the sitemap all read the same map (`src/pages/Activities.tsx:21`, `scripts/sitemap.ts:14`).

There is no runtime validation of the map. A slug that collides with an existing one silently wins or loses depending on declaration order.
